item.title: Quantinuum Revenue Jumps 279% in First Earnings Report Since IPO
item.summary: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — Quantinuum reported sharply higher revenue in its first quarterly earnings report as a public company, while a $1.7 billion initial public offering gives the quantum computing company a substantial cash reserve to pursue an ambitious hardware roadmap. The trapped-ion quantum computing company reported second-quarter revenue of $8 million, up 279% […]
